212:t_1:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...How long has it been since we got separated from $c...?」

212:t_1:9.en:
$n
「We're sending a distress signal. I'm sure $c will find us.」

212:t_1:10.en:
$n
「That $$時空震動$$ sent us all flying, so everyone should be nearby too.」

212:t_1:12.en:
$n
「We'll be fine, Miss $$スズネ$$. $$ＡＧ$$ would never abandon his precious $$ジェニオン$$.」

212:t_1:13.en:
$n
「He'll use that dimensional merchant information network he's so proud of, or whatever else it takes, to find us.」

212:t_1:15.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ has an emergency survival kit, and our suits... um...」

212:t_1:16.en:
$n
「...They a-automatically break down our waste and teleport it away, too...」

212:t_1:17.en:
$n
「And as a last resort, we can use the cold sleep system.」

212:t_1:23.en:
$n
「I was... wondering if $$宗介$$ is all right...」

212:t_1:25.en:
$n
「Not just $$宗介$$... I was thinking about everyone in $c... And about Earth.」

212:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even though we don't know what's going to happen to us...?」

212:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I can do something about my own problems if I take action.」

212:t_1:28.en:
$n
「But when it comes to other people... all I can do is wait...」

212:t_1:29.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're staying positive even in a situation like this...」

212:t_1:30.en:
$n
「You're the one who taught me that, Miss $$スズネ$$. You and everyone else.」

212:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Everyone gets discouraged sometimes. So right now, I'll protect you.」

212:t_1:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You've been protecting me ever since we first boarded the $$ジェニオン$$, $n.」

212:t_1:34.en:
$n
「That's not true. You're the one who's been protecting me.」

212:t_1:35.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Protecting each other... I think that's what being partners means...」

212:t_1:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Though in my case, there's my responsibility as your teacher, too.」

212:t_1:37.en:
$n
「But the special training course is over now, right? We were supposed to have the completion ceremony yesterday.」

212:t_1:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then will you call me $$スズネ$$ from now on?」

212:t_1:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If the two of us keep wandering through space and reach some planet, shall we become its Adam and Eve?」

212:t_1:43.en:
$n
「That's not it, but I'm not mentally prepared...!」

212:t_1:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm joking. Did that cheer you up a little?」

212:t_1:47.en:
$n
「Cheer me up...? You're the one who was feeling down, $$スズネ$$.」

212:t_1:49.en:
$n
「That's payback for what you said earlier.」

212:t_1:51.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Lately... you've been helping me so much.」

212:t_1:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You paid that debt back long ago...」

212:t_1:55.en:
$n
「...I've been thinking all this time. With everyone helping me so much, what could I do with the $$ジェニオン$$...?」

212:t_1:56.en:
$n
「My answer was to fight and grow stronger so I could protect someone, but...」

212:t_1:57.en:
$n
「Lately, I've started to understand that what I was missing was strength in the truest sense.」

212:t_1:59.en:
$n
「Doing what I need to do... without clinging to convenient hopes or lashing out in despair...」

212:t_1:60.en:
$n
「When I can do that... I think I'll be even stronger.」

212:t_1:61.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you mean what happened back in $$ラース・バビロン$$...?」

212:t_1:62.en:
$n
「In that moment... I felt like I'd overcome something, just a little.」

212:t_1:63.en:
$n
(If I can gain that strength, then surely I can deal with Mom, too...)

212:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「An approach warning...! Has $c come for us...!?」

212:t_1:65.en:
$n
「...I'm not getting any identification response... Whatever it is, we don't know it.」

212:t_1:67.en:
$n
「With those numbers... and that speed... We can't escape.」

212:t_1:69.en:
$n
「I don't know what's coming, but we have to make contact.」

212:t_1:70.en:
$n
「For now, let's do everything we can to survive.」

212:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n is scared too... But I'm sure he's trying not to worry me...)

212:t_1:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What do I do...? Even in a situation like this... my heart won't stop racing...)

212:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've made up my mind, $n... Whatever happens, I'll follow you...)

212:t_1:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is near, I'll believe in the strength you seek.)

213:t_000:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness... You've been unconscious all this time...」
